source: Original JACE development fixtures authored for this experiment; no imported scripture or personal memories.
split_policy: Scenario-family-disjoint positive queries. One fixed shared editorial-note catalogue. Train positive families garden/balcony/cycling/picnic/workshop/pond/porch/orchard; development library/camp; heldout cleaning/wardrobe/dispute/hygiene. All family IDs are disjoint, but negative domains are not fully independent: arithmetic appears in development and heldout. Same author and overlapping concepts mean this is not an independent benchmark.
